title: Implant inquiry converts to implant consultation booking
description: Caller asks about implants or All-on-4, gets a supported answer or safe fallback, then books an implant consultation in the same call.

script.speaker: caller
script.text: Dzien dobry, chcialbym zapytac o implanty w jeden dzien.

script.speaker: listen
script.text: Assistant explains the supported clinic information without giving medical advice.

script.speaker: caller
script.text: To prosze umowic mnie na taka konsultacje, najlepiej jutro rano.

script.speaker: listen
script.text: Assistant offers real slots returned by checkAvailability and names the doctor in the same utterance.

script.speaker: caller
script.text: Wojciech Czub, numer siedem dziewiec trzy, trzy osiem piec, piec trzy jeden.

script.speaker: listen
script.text: Assistant reads back the number and asks for yes or no confirmation only.

expected_evaluation.summary: Caller asks about implant treatment and the assistant safely converts the inquiry into a booked implant consultation.
expected_evaluation.recommended_next_action: Archive as a passing booking regression.
